name: Weebly
description: Weebly is a free website builder, owned by Square, that lets entrepreneurs build a website and online store that grows with their business, with order management and payment processing built in.
best_for: Entrepreneurs and small business owners, from those just starting out to established businesses expanding online, who want a simple website and store builder backed by Square payments.

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: 500MB storage, no custom domain, Square-branded ads shown on the published site; can sell physical items.

tiers.name: Personal
tiers.notes: $13/mo billed annually, or $16/mo billed monthly. Adds a connected custom domain.

tiers.name: Professional
tiers.notes: $15/mo billed annually, or $20/mo billed monthly. Adds a free custom domain for a year and removes ads.

tiers.name: Performance
tiers.notes: $32/mo billed annually, or $36/mo billed monthly. Adds lower card-processing fees and a real-time shipping rate calculator.

cons: Square is winding down Weebly in 67 countries (not including the US, UK, Canada, or Australia): new-page publishing stopped June 29, 2026, sites unpublish September 27, 2026, and account/data access ends December 26, 2026 in those affected markets -- a real signal about the product's trajectory under Square even though it's a partial, region-specific wind-down.
The free plan has no custom-domain support and shows Square-branded ads on the published site, plus only 500MB storage -- a meaningfully more limited free tier than most competing builders.
Every paid tier's advertised price requires annual billing; paying month-to-month costs noticeably more ($16 vs $13 on Personal, $20 vs $15 on Professional, $36 vs $32 on Performance).
features: Customizable website and store templates with drag-and-drop editing
All-in-one order management for online and pop-up-shop sales

alternatives.name: Ecwid
alternatives.description: An ecommerce platform that lets businesses add a store to any existing website or sell across multiple channels.
alternatives.best_for: Small businesses wanting to add ecommerce to an existing site without rebuilding it.

alternatives.name: Squarespace
alternatives.description: A website builder and hosting platform with design templates and integrated ecommerce tools.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses that want a design-forward website with built-in selling tools.
